## Challenge

Link the challenge issue you are responding to.

## Proposed approach

Explain the idea clearly enough that someone else could test it.

## Why it should work

Describe the root cause you believe this addresses.

## Verification plan

How would you prove the solution meets the challenge acceptance criteria?

## Tradeoffs / limitations

List important downsides, assumptions, dependencies, or platform-specific behavior.

Do not include private source code, credentials, personal information, production secrets, or unrelated proprietary material.
